name: Comparable sales and leases
what: The set of comparable sales and leases gathered to test a price and a rent, each with what makes it comparable.

fields.label: Subject property
fields.definition: The property the set is gathered for, with the size, type and features the comparables are measured against.

fields.label: Prepared
fields.definition: The date the set was compiled; the comparables speak only to the market up to this date.

fields.label: Search criteria
fields.definition: The area, date range, size range and property types searched, so a reader can see what could have been found and was not.

fields.label: Sale or lease
fields.definition: For each comparable, whether it is a sale or a lease.

fields.label: Address
fields.definition: The comparable's street address and, for a lease, the suite.

fields.label: Date
fields.definition: The closing date of a sale, or the signing or commencement date of a lease; say which.

fields.label: Area
fields.definition: The building square feet sold or the space leased, and whether rentable or gross.

fields.label: Sale price
fields.definition: The recorded or confirmed price for a sale; null for a lease.

fields.label: Price per square foot
fields.definition: Sale price divided by building area.

fields.label: Cap rate
fields.definition: The cap rate at sale and the income it was figured on, in-place or projected; null if not known.

fields.label: Starting rent
fields.definition: The first-year base rent of a lease per square foot per year; null for a sale.

fields.label: Expense basis
fields.definition: Whether a lease rent is gross, modified gross or triple net, so rents are compared on one basis before they are averaged.

fields.label: Term and concessions
fields.definition: The lease term in months, annual steps, free rent and improvement allowance, which move the effective rent away from the starting rent.

fields.label: Physical characteristics
fields.definition: Year built, site size, and for industrial the clear height, loading, office share and yard, as far as they bear on comparability.

fields.label: Conditions of the deal
fields.definition: Anything that made the price or rent unusual, such as a sale-leaseback, a related-party deal, a distressed seller, or a portfolio allocation.

fields.label: Source and verification
fields.definition: Where each figure came from, such as the offering memorandum, a broker, a data service, a deed or the appraisal district, and who confirmed it and on what date; the comp's status is recorded on its own in Confirmation status.

fields.label: Confirmation status
fields.definition: For each comparable: confirmed by a party to the deal, confirmed by a public record only, or unconfirmed (reported by a broker or data service and not yet checked). A source is not a confirmation: a database record stays unconfirmed until a party or a record confirms it.

fields.label: Net effective rent
fields.definition: For a lease, the rent over the term after free rent, the improvement allowance and commissions, spread evenly per square foot per year on the subject's expense basis, with the method used (for example, the lease-rent calculator's run); null for a sale.

fields.label: Adjustments
fields.definition: For each comparable, each adjustment toward the subject: the factor (conditions of sale, market conditions, location, size, age and condition, quality, lease terms), the percentage or amount, its direction and the reason; or, where the comps are bracketed, whether the comp is better or worse than the subject.

fields.label: Adjusted price or rent
fields.definition: Each comparable's price per square foot or net effective rent after its adjustments, in the unit of the figure adjusted; null where the comps are bracketed and not adjusted.

fields.label: Concluded ranges
fields.definition: The concluded low and high for price per square foot, cap rate and market rent, each with the comps that support each end, the statistic the conclusion rests on (mean, median or weighted mean), how many comps are confirmed, and where the evidence is thin.
